title: Principled Data Selection for Alignment: The Hidden Risks of Difficult Examples
authors_zh: Chengqian Gao、Haonan Li、Liu Liu、Zeke Xie、Peilin Zhao、Zhiqiang Xu
paper_type_zh: 偏好样本难度选择与直接偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究模型容量如何决定偏好记录可训练性的读者。
one_line: Selective DPO filters preference pairs that are too difficult for the current model capacity.
Selective DPO 按模型容量筛除过难的偏好对，再执行直接偏好优化。
why: It treats data difficulty as a training-use decision rather than assuming every clean preference pair is beneficial.
inclusion_reason: Changes which preference pairs enter DPO according to difficulty relative to the training model's capacity.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference-data curation often treats clean examples as uniformly helpful. The paper shows that preference pairs have stable but unequal learning difficulty, and examples beyond a model's capacity can degrade alignment even when they are not simply mislabeled.

It asks how DPO should choose records for a particular model size. Selective DPO estimates how difficult each pair is for that model and removes pairs whose difficulty exceeds the useful range.

偏好数据整理通常把干净样本视为同样有帮助。论文显示，偏好对具有稳定但不相等的学习难度，而超出模型容量的样本即使并非只是错标，也会损害对齐。

它追问 DPO 应如何为特定模型大小选择记录。Selective DPO 估计每个回答对对该模型的难度，并移除难度超过有效范围的回答对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is that an example's value depends on the learner, not only on its label quality. Validation loss from independently trained DPO reference models is used as a computational proxy for the step at which a pair becomes learnable.

The final training set is therefore a capacity-matched subset. Larger models can retain a larger share of hard pairs, while smaller models benefit from excluding examples that their current preference representation cannot reliably learn.

核心想法是样本的价值取决于学习者，而不只取决于标签质量。由独立训练的 DPO 参考模型产生的验证损失，被用作回答对在何时变得可学习的计算代理。

因此，最终训练集是与容量匹配的子集。较大模型可以保留更多困难回答对，而较小模型则受益于排除当前偏好表示无法可靠学习的样本。

title: Method
方法
html:
The training data are repeatedly split in two. DPO models trained on each partition score the held-out partition, and the resulting validation losses are averaged to rank individual preference pairs by difficulty.

Selective DPO selects a thresholded prefix of this ranking and runs ordinary DPO only on that subset. The authors use three splits, yielding six reference models, and tune the selected fraction to the target model capacity.

训练数据被反复二分。每个分区上训练的 DPO 模型为保留分区打分，所得验证损失取平均值，从而按难度对单条偏好对排序。

Selective DPO 选择该排序中由阈值确定的前缀，仅在该子集上运行普通 DPO。作者使用三个划分得到六个参考模型，并将选择比例调节到目标模型容量。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across two datasets and four model families, the paper reports that high-validation-loss examples reduce alignment performance. The reported capacity study finds the preferred retained fraction rising from 64% for a 3B Qwen model to 81% for a 14B model.

Selective DPO is reported to improve AlpacaEval 2 win rate by 9–16% over DPO and to outperform several objective-level variants in the tested settings. The result supports capacity-aware selection, but its validation-loss proxy and threshold require rechecking for another model or dataset.

在两个数据集和四个模型家族上，论文报告高验证损失样本会降低对齐表现。所报告的容量研究发现，Qwen 3B 模型偏好的保留比例为 64%，而 Qwen 14B 为 81%。

论文报告 Selective DPO 相比 DPO 将 AlpacaEval 2 胜率提高 9–16%，并在测试设置中优于若干目标函数级变体。结果支持容量感知选择，但对另一模型或数据集，验证损失代理和阈值都需要重新检查。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier curation emphasizes noise, reward margin, or broad quality. This work isolates learnability relative to a target policy: a pair may be correctly labeled yet harmful because its preference distinction is currently too difficult.

The novelty is a model-capacity-aware selection rule built from cross-fitted validation loss, not a new DPO objective. It converts a claim about learning order into a concrete decision about which records the final optimizer consumes.

较早的整理强调噪声、奖励间隔或广义质量。本工作隔离与目标策略相对的可学习性：一个回答对可能标注正确，却因为其偏好差异当前过难而有害。

新意是由交叉拟合验证损失构建的模型容量感知选择规则，而不是新的 DPO 目标。它将关于学习顺序的主张转化为最终优化器实际使用哪些记录的具体决策。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method needs several preliminary reference-model trainings, so it trades final-DPO data efficiency for significant curation cost. Validation loss can confound difficulty with distribution shift or imperfect reference training, and the best threshold changes with model capacity. It also does not replace upstream checks for label correctness, licenses, or benchmark leakage.
该方法需要若干预先的参考模型训练，因此它用显著的整理成本换取最终 DPO 的数据效率。验证损失可能将难度与分布变化或不完善的参考训练混淆，最佳阈值也会随模型容量改变。它同样不能替代对上游标签正确性、许可证或基准泄漏的检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a fixed preference corpus contains examples that seem clean but destabilize a smaller alignment model. It provides a reproducible way to estimate a capacity-matched subset and a concrete warning against assuming that more preference data is always better.
当固定偏好语料包含看似干净、却会使较小对齐模型不稳定的样本时，应使用这项工作。它提供估计容量匹配子集的可复现方式，并具体警示不能假定更多偏好数据总是更好。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the learned-step and validation-loss analyses before the final benchmark table. For reproduction, separately record the reference-model splits, target-model size, loss-ranking procedure, selected fraction, and whether the evaluation data were held out from every selection decision.
应在最终基准表之前先阅读学习步数和验证损失分析。复现时要分别记录参考模型划分、目标模型大小、损失排序过程、选择比例，以及评估数据是否从所有选择决策中保留。
